posts.title: India, my way
posts.description: Diwali is long over, but then again, I have never needed any special occasion to indulge my interests! For as long as I can remember, I have been in love with India’s extraordinary cultural heritage. Over the years, that love has found its way into my library and even the decorations around my home. So, for no particular reason other than the pleasure of sharing them, I thought I would show you some of my Indian treasures—and there’s more to them than just Bāla Kṛṣṇa mischievously hiding in my cupboard . . . Let me begin with India’s amazing literary heritage, particularly the Mahābhārata and the writings of Rabindranath Tagore . . . I consider Tagore one of the greatest writers who ever lived—certainly among my personal favorites, and, if you ask me, a far greater (and definitely more lucid) literary genius than the overrated Shakespeare.
